reviewMethod: Viewed all twelve actual CI images in two labeled, aspect-preserving nearest-neighbor overview sheets (originals 120x80 or 144x96). Original PPM and scene JSON retained. Overview sheets are review derivatives, not synthetic outputs or original-artifact replacements.
observations: Five bust views retain complete head/shoulder geometry; the side camera changes silhouette; the rim-only fixture shows the expected dark front and narrow illuminated rim.
Hard/key-only fixtures show sharp panel shadows; large soft fixtures show smoother shadow transitions. No visible magenta unsupported-pixel regions or torn geometry.

Exposure-minus-two darkens the sphere and panel. Warm is a historical fixture name: its actual scene JSON sets 3200 K white balance under 5600 K key/fill with +1 exposure, so its blue cast is expected. White-balance-3200 uses the same correction at 0 exposure.
All twelve are low-resolution synthetic diagnostic outputs; this review does not establish realistic skin/material rendering, photographic calibration, native Metal execution or device performance.
status: No concrete geometry/shadow/color/exposure defect observed in this synthetic matrix
derivativeCorrection: Initial overview sheets used square thumbnails; replaced with original 3:2 aspect ratio and re-reviewed before acceptance.
